summary: Example registering a file's JSON content via shell and parsing it into a variable with from_json and set_fact.
questions: How do I load a JSON file from a remote host into a variable?
How do I parse command output as JSON?

answer_card.title: Parsing JSON output into a variable
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.shell: cat /some/path/to/file.json
  register: result
- ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    myvar: "{{ result.stdout | from_json }}"
```
